policy.method: Explicitly reviewed 2.236 mm LV95 gap between two non-tunnel Bus source-feature endpoints at Oberbuchsiten. Preserve original vertices and add one separately identified inferred connector, only in a supplementary graph for exact PostAuto 126 route and directed platform pair. No global near-endpoint stitching, coordinate replacement, road direction or present-day operator itinerary certification.
